text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THAWRA
- Turkish sources say Washington and Tel Aviv take part in Turkish military invasion of northern Iraq.
- Demand escalates for Iraqi oil.
- Kuwaiti pilots go on strike.
- Culture and information minister receives Chinese ambassador.
- Agriculture minister receives French delegation.
- Lebanese trade delegation leaves Iraq.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial blames the United States for the worsening humanitarian situation in Iraq.
- Commentary says America cannot be friendly to Arabs.
- Article on Turkish policy vis-a-vis regional issues.
JUMHOURIYA
- International Atomic Energy Agency lauds Iraq's cooperation in scrapping its nuclear potential.
- Algeria tells Turkey to withdraw from northern Iraq.
- Editorial says if Turkey sets up a security cordon in northern Iraq, the area will not be safe for Turkish troops.
- Washington utilises famine in North Korea for its own interests.
- Political motives behind the assassination attempt on the life of a Kuwaiti MP.
AL-IRAQ
- Editorial on U.S. crimes against Iraq.
